def transform(grid):
    """Copy the non-background design above a uniform divider into the rows below it."""
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    div = next((r for r, row in enumerate(grid)
                if len(set(row)) == 1 and row[0] not in (9,)), None)
    if div is None:
        return out
    for r in range(div + 1, h):
        src = r - (div + 1)
        if src < div:
            for c in range(w):
                if grid[src][c] != 9:
                    out[r][c] = grid[src][c]
    return out
